nodes.label: Release Baseline (last tag)
nodes.rationale: The notes range starts at the most recent release tag; with no tag anywhere the baseline is the root commit, so a first release still has a well-defined range.

nodes.label: Stale Local Tags
nodes.rationale: A tag can exist on the remote and be invisible locally, turning 'there is no previous release' into a false premise; fetching tags before reading them removes the failure.

nodes.label: Version Drift
nodes.rationale: If the tag and the version declared in code disagree, the release drifts from what it actually ships, so every version-declaring file is reconciled before publishing.

nodes.label: English Release Notes
nodes.rationale: Notes are written in English regardless of the conversation language, for a reader who was not in it, and lead with behaviour changes because an upgrader asks first what breaks.

nodes.label: gh release create (tag + publish)
nodes.rationale: gh release create makes the tag from --target, so no separate git tag step exists; the release is reversible with gh release delete --cleanup-tag.
